question: Natya Visharadha presented by His Excellency Shankar Dayal Sharma, in 1994 was given to _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**G. Padmaja Reddy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Natya Visharadha** is a prestigious award presented by the **Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya Mandal**, an institution dedicated to the promotion and preservation of Indian classical** music and dance.**
 
• Natya Visharadha presented by His Excellency Shankar Dayal Sharma, in **1994** was given to **G. Padmaja Reddy.**
 
• G. Padmaja Reddy is a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer from **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• She has been trained in the **Kuchipudi dance** form and has performed extensively in India and abroad.
 
• She is also the founder of the **Kuchipudi Art Academy in Hyderabad**, which is dedicated to the training and promotion of Kuchipudi dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunanda Nair** is a contemporary **dancer and choreographer** from **Kerala.**

 
 
• Indian dancer Sunanda Nair has received training in **mohiniattam.**
 
 
 
• **Shovana Narayan **is a classical dancer from **Delhi.**
 
 
• She is trained in the **Kathak** dance form.
 
• She has performed extensively both in **India and abroad **and has received several awards for her contributions to the field of dance.
 
 
 
• **Anuradha Pandey **is a **Kathak** dancer and choreographer.
 
 
• She is from **Lucknow.**
 
• She has trained under several renowned gurus and has performed extensively in** India and abroad.**
